My plot is small, only 0.13 hectares, and I grow groundnuts intercropped with other crops to feed my family and sell a little at the market. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer, and groundnuts fix their own nitrogen anyway, so I rely on the manure I get from our few animals and from neighbors. I use seeds I saved from last season because improved seed is expensive and hard to find here in Lindi. My husband and I will do most of the weeding and harvesting ourselves, and I may call on one or two people during harvest if the crop is good.
